title: Research-only typed prescribed-groundwater-level control and candidate-output contract

requested_H_phreatic.meaning: The groundwater-level control requested by the coupling trial.

effective_H_phreatic.legacy_analogue: state%gwlinp after the 1e-4 cm node-snap rule
effective_H_phreatic.meaning: The actual control coordinate used by the source state machine for the trial.

derived_profile_GWL.legacy_analogue: gwl as produced by calcgwl() in SoilWater task 3
derived_profile_GWL.meaning: A groundwater-level diagnostic derived from the candidate hydraulic profile; it is not the same typed object as the prescribed control merely because they may coincide in a hydrostatic case.

lower_face_pressure_head.meaning: Derived lower-face pressure head used when fllowgwl=true; hbot=effective_H_phreatic-z_bottom_face.

bottom_flux.meaning: Diagnosed outward/downward lower-boundary flux. It is an output of prescribed-GWL semantics and is never an independently prescribed input in LOW01.

ABOVE_OR_AT_TOP.derived_profile_GWL: not available from focused HeadCalc alone unless an explicit profile-GWL diagnostic is executed after the candidate is formed
ABOVE_OR_AT_TOP.qbot: HeadCalc source branch directly reconstructs the vertical flux chain and assigns qbot before returning

INSIDE_PROFILE.requested_and_effective_head: preserve both because source node-snap may mutate gwlinp
INSIDE_PROFILE.derived_profile_GWL: not available from focused HeadCalc alone; legacy SoilWater calls calcgwl() later in task 3
INSIDE_PROFILE.qbot: HeadCalc success branch reconstructs whole-profile vertical fluxes after saturated continuation and assigns qbot=vertical_flux(n+1)
INSIDE_PROFILE.active_domain: branch id and active NN belong to candidate provenance even if NN is reconstructed rather than instrumented

BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE.derived_profile_GWL: not available from focused HeadCalc alone unless separately diagnosed
BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE.hbot: derive from explicit bottom-face geometry and effective_H_phreatic
BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE.qbot: HeadCalc uses the same lower-head residual/Jacobian family as mode 5 but does not independently provide the focused adapter's accepted-step whole-profile qbot materialization. Research LOW01 must apply the same explicit provider/state arithmetic as materialize_prescribed_head_bottom_flux after successful solve.

typed_candidate_minimum: candidate ponding/process state required for mass closure
derived_profile_GWL only when an explicit source-equivalent diagnostic has run
explicit_non_aliases: qbot is output, not a second groundwater control
current soil_water_solve_result_t.candidate_state.groundwater_level cannot alone carry both control and derived-profile semantics

g4_resolution.finding: Current focused HeadCalc success does not visibly execute calcgwl(); SoilWater task 3 does. Therefore mapping state%gwl directly to a prescribed-H_phreatic result would conflate a derived diagnostic with the control coordinate.
g4_resolution.decision: Research LOW01 candidate objects must expose requested/effective H_phreatic independently. derived_profile_GWL remains unavailable unless separately materialized from the candidate profile with source-equivalent calcgwl semantics.

g5_resolution.finding: Mode-1 qbot has branch-specific source authority: direct flux-chain assignment for ABOVE/INSIDE branches, and lower-head residual plus explicit accepted-step materialization for BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE.
g5_resolution.decision: Define one typed qbot output with provenance field bottom_flux_materialization_route. For below-profile research, reuse the already-qualified mode-5 materialization arithmetic; for inside-profile, preserve the source vertical-flux-chain qbot.

qualification_dependencies.LOW01_A2: live below-profile solve and qbot/mass materialization
qualification_dependencies.LOW01_B: provider-owned constitutive continuation plus typed candidate object satisfying this result contract
qualification_dependencies.LOW01_D: immutable-origin transaction wrapper must snapshot all typed candidate-control/provenance fields

forbidden: do not set candidate_state.groundwater_level=gwlinp merely to make a test pass
do not infer calcgwl output from the prescribed control without executing or independently proving the source-equivalent profile diagnostic
do not prescribe qbot in LOW01
do not expose bottom_mode=1 through the production solver adapter from this design
do not change current mode-5 F-GC semantics
next: Qualify the bounded KSATEXM-off constitutive bridge.
Build a research-only LOW01 candidate wrapper carrying the fields in this contract; do not reuse soil_water_solve_result_t groundwater_level as the control field.
Use that wrapper for LOW01-D below-profile transaction replay before returning to inside-profile LOW01-B.
